business_problem: Facing the challenge of building a near real-time event pipeline, Kaltura streamlined and enhanced its workflows by deploying Databricks Data + AI Platform and dbt to replace its legacy architecture. Seeking to support all the company’s data needs, Kaltura’s data team recently set out to build a new data lake platform that would replace legacy infrastructure.
solution_summary: Kaltura’s mission is to power any video experience for any organization. Customers deploy the company’s wide array of video solutions to help them teach, learn, communicate, collaborate and entertain. Facing the challenge of building a near real-time event pipeline, Kaltura streamlined and enhanced its workflows by deploying Databricks Data + AI Platform and dbt to replace its legacy architecture. This resulted in faster processing speeds and fewer man-hours spent. The company also supports ambitious, resource-intensive new use cases in the lakehouse. As Kaltura’s computing needs continue to increase, the data team can easily scale up resources in Databricks. Around that time, Kaltura’s team heard the buzz about data lakes and decided to try Databricks Data + AI Platform. The company soon launched a proof of concept.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, self-service queries, and business intelligence for downstream users.

solution_components.name: dbt
solution_components.role: Models and tests ELT transformations running on Databricks.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables used for reliable downstream analytics and AI workloads.

data_flow: Operational, customer, and transactional data lands in Databricks, is transformed in Delta Lake tables, with pipelines coordinated through Databricks orchestration and transformation services, and is served to downstream users and applications through Databricks SQL.
business_outcome: Reported outcomes include 20% Reduction in AWS fees; 92% Reduction in latency for support engineers to get data logs.
metrics: 92% Reduction in latency for support engineers to get data logs
